snippet.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chornobyl — Enhanced Edition Trailer
snippet.description:
Step back into the Zone where it all began. S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chornobyl has been remastered as part of the Legends of the Zone Trilogy, bringing the iconic survival shooter into a new era. With enhanced and upscaled visuals, the game's bleak, atmospheric world now looks sharper and more haunting than ever. Follow the story of Marked One through a twisted landscape of radiation, anomalies, and rival stalkers — a place where every step could be your last.
More than a visual upgrade — it’s a return to one of the most iconic survival FPS experiences. Available on May 20, 2025, for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.
